tldr: Jupiter through the 3rd house expands messages, conversations, learning, and daily movement.
body:
When Jupiter moves through your 3rd house, it makes more room around messages, conversations, errands, siblings, neighbors, learning, planning, and what needs to be said. You may notice more activity in your immediate world: conversations to have, details to track, short trips to make, or a decision that needs clearer words.

Hope, appetite, confidence, opportunity, and risk can all get bigger. It can help you say yes to something that gives your life more range.

The useful side is that this timing can make the next honest move easier to see. This is useful for naming the thing that has been circling in your mind.

The caution: Watch for taking on more than the situation, your schedule, or your judgment can hold. The risk is getting scattered by every message, detail, or possible interpretation.

Jupiter moves through this house for about a year. Let the opening be real, but keep your promises sized to the life you can actually live.
